reuse.why: All six linking handlers share the new guard and reuse findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, although local unlink cleanup is copied.

duplication.why: Fintegra duplicates the existing link workflow and transaction downloader, while replacement duplicates unlinkAccount's field-clearing block.

placement.why: Provider types, configuration and downloads follow existing layers, but account detachment is unexpectedly embedded in a validation helper.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on linking safeguards, Fintegra integration and replacement support.

maintainability.why: Centralized linking rules help maintenance, but duplicated workflows and destructive updates inside ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked obscure ownership and sequencing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing applicable bank lookup and sync helpers are used; unlinkAccount also performs provider cleanup, so it cannot directly serve local-only replacement.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount reproduces existing provider linking with different field selections, and downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing authenticated transaction-download sequence.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink, a closed-target rejection branch and a replacement branch that mutates the previous account; all six linking handlers still call it.
